name: fraud
notes: Synthetic card transactions, ~2% fraud, planted conjunctive signatures. Imbalanced binary.

goal.description: Detect fraudulent card transactions. Fraud is rare (~2%); rank suspicious transactions well (average precision) and keep probabilities calibrated.
